task.description:
WF-04 Step 3 — Integration Tests. Run all backend integration tests against a real PostgreSQL database.

PRE-CONDITION: Test PostgreSQL database must be running with all migrations applied.
If the test DB is not available, start it via docker-compose and apply migrations first.

1. Ensure PostgreSQL is running (e.g., `docker-compose up -d postgres`)
2. Apply migrations: `zig build migrate`
3. Run integration tests: `zig build test-integration`

Pay special attention to:
- Idempotency tests (ES-03)
- Transaction atomicity (DB-03)
- Concurrency tests (EE-12, scheduler)

Classify failures:
- BLOCKER: test covers a MUST requirement
- MAJOR: test covers a SHOULD requirement
- MINOR: other

Write results to tests/reports/WF04-full-20260523-step03-integration.md
acceptance_criteria: zig build test-integration exits 0 (or only MINOR failures)
All MUST/SHOULD requirement integration tests pass

result.summary: Integration tests FAILED: 125 pass, 21 fail (146 total), 2 memory leaks. 16 BLOCKER failures across PD-08, EE-01, EE-09, EE-10. 5 MAJOR failures across API-02, API-03. Root causes: DuplicateNameVersion (test data isolation), GraphValidationFailed (graph validator rejecting error-test graphs), pool connection error, AlreadyActive not returned, cancelInstance ServerError.

issues.description: DuplicateNameVersion on DefinitionStore.create() — 14 tests (PD-08: 5, EE-09: 4, EE-10: 3) fail because (name, version) already exists in test DB
GraphValidationFailed on EE-10 error-test graphs — TC-EE-10-01,02,03 rejected by graph validator
ADDRESS_ALREADY_EXISTS during pool connection in TC-EE-01-06 — pool exhaustion or Windows socket collision
AlreadyActive error not returned in TC-API-02-29 — activate() succeeds on already-ACTIVE definition; 2 memory leaks
PgError.ServerError during cancelInstance() in TC-API-03-05,15,18 — 3 tests fail
tasks assertion failed in TC-API-03-01 — getById did not return expected tasks

result.next_action: Route to ORCH — spawn WF-03 ISSUE-FIXER with priority on DuplicateNameVersion root cause (14 tests) and GraphValidationFailed (3 tests)
